title: AI/ML Engineer
description: Develop intelligent models, scalable machine learning pipelines, deep neural networks, transformer architectures, and production MLOps deployment systems.

goal.objective: Design, train, optimize, and deploy robust machine learning models and deep neural architectures into scalable, low-latency production systems.

learn.summary: Master applied mathematics (linear algebra, calculus, probability), Python for scientific computing, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, model optimization, feature stores, and MLOps deployment.

capstone_projects.title: Real-Time Multimodal Semantic Search & RAG System
capstone_projects.description: Build an enterprise semantic retrieval engine utilizing CLIP embeddings and cross-encoder rerankers with sub-50ms latency.

capstone_projects.title: Distributed Image Classification & Model Serving Pipeline
capstone_projects.description: Train and deploy a ResNet/Vision Transformer pipeline with automated drift monitoring and canary model deployments.

certifications: Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer
interview_focus: Model Serving Latency vs Throughput Tradeoffs

tree.name: Programming and Math Foundations
tree.description: Establish an unshakeable mathematical and programming foundation for artificial intelligence: vectorized scientific computing, linear algebra transformations, multivariate calculus for backpropagation, and rigorous probability theory.

resources.title: Python for Data Science - Course for Beginners
Linear Algebra Course – Mathematics for Machine Learning and Generative AI

children.name: Python Programming Fundamentals
children.description: Master vectorized Python programming for machine learning. Deep dive into NumPy array memory layouts (C-contiguous vs Fortran-contiguous, strides, views vs copies), broadcasting rules, memory-efficient data loading, and profiling code bottlenecks using cProfile and line_profiler.

resources.title: Learn Python - Full Course for Beginners [Tutorial]

children.name: Data Manipulation & Visualization
children.description: Master high-performance tabular data engineering with Polars (lazy execution, multi-threaded SIMD processing) and Pandas 2.0 (PyArrow backend). Clean messy real-world datasets, handle missing data without leakage, and create insightful statistical visualizations with Seaborn and Plotly.

resources.title: Learn Python for Data Analysis with NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib

children.name: Linear Algebra for ML
children.description: Master the linear algebra that powers neural networks and representations: vector spaces, dot products and projections, matrix multiplication complexity, matrix decompositions (SVD, Eigenvalues/Eigenvectors, QR decomposition), and high-dimensional latent embeddings.

resources.title: Linear Algebra for Machine Learning Course (with Python)

children.name: Calculus for ML
children.description: Master multivariable calculus for deep learning optimization: partial derivatives, gradients, directional derivatives, Jacobian and Hessian matrices, the multivariate chain rule (the mathematical foundation of backpropagation), and gradient descent optimization dynamics (SGD with Momentum, AdamW).

children.name: Probability and Statistics for ML
children.description: Master statistical inference and probability theory: common distributions (Gaussian, Bernoulli, Poisson), Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), Maximum A Posteriori (MAP), Bayesian inference, hypothesis testing, and evaluating models under extreme class imbalance (PR-AUC vs ROC-AUC, F-beta).

resources.title: Statistics and Probability Full Course || Statistics For Data Science

tree.name: Classical Machine Learning
tree.description: Master classical machine learning algorithms, rigorous cross-validation pipelines, feature engineering, hyperparameter optimization, and explainable AI techniques.

resources.title: Machine Learning Full Course - Learn Machine Learning 10 Hours | Machine Learning Tutorial | Edureka
Machine Learning for Everybody - Full Course

children.name: Supervised Learning Algorithms
children.description: Master supervised learning algorithms: Linear and Logistic Regression with L1/L2 regularization, Support Vector Machines (kernel trick), and gradient-boosted decision trees (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost). Understand loss function optimization and handling heterogeneous tabular data.

children.name: Unsupervised Learning & Dim. Reduction
children.description: Master unsupervised learning and dimensionality reduction: clustering algorithms (K-Means, DBSCAN, Gaussian Mixture Models) and projection techniques (PCA for multicollinearity reduction, t-SNE and UMAP for high-dimensional latent space exploration and visualization).

resources.title: Unsupervised Machine Learning in Python Tutorial | K-Means Clustering, PCA, & More

children.name: Feature Engineering & Selection
children.description: Engineer high-signal features without data leakage. Master target encoding with out-of-fold cross-validation, cyclical feature encoding for time, robust scaling (RobustScaler, QuantileTransformer), and automated feature selection techniques (Recursive Feature Elimination, SHAP-based selection).

resources.title: Feature Engineering for Machine Learning (O'Reilly book/course)
Feature Engineering for Machine Learning Tutorial

children.name: Model Validation & Hyperparameter Tuning
children.description: Implement leak-free model evaluation and tuning. Design stratified K-fold and TimeSeriesSplit cross-validation strategies, and optimize hyperparameters efficiently using Bayesian optimization with Optuna (Tree-structured Parzen Estimator / TPE and Hyperband pruning).

resources.title: How to Evaluate and Select Your Machine Learning Models in Python with scikit-learn
Machine Learning Tutorial Python - 16: Hyper parameter Tuning (GridSearchCV) (codebasics)

children.name: Model Interpretability (XAI)
children.description: Implement Explainable AI (XAI) in production models. Leverage SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) for global and local feature importance, TreeSHAP for fast tree-based explanations, and partial dependence plots to ensure model decisions comply with regulatory and audit standards.

resources.title: Explainable AI Made Easy: SHAP, LIME & PFI with Hands-On Coding
XAI Explainable AI LIME SHAP With Python Hands On Implementation For Beginners

children.name: Practice: Advanced Classical ML Project
children.description: Practice Project: Architect an end-to-end production tabular predictive pipeline using Scikit-Learn Pipeline and ColumnTransformer. Integrate automated feature preprocessing, hyperparameter optimization with Optuna, leak-free cross-validation, and export to ONNX format.

resources.title: Kaggle Learn - Intro to Machine Learning
End-to-End Machine Learning Project with Scikit-learn

tree.name: Deep Learning and Modern AI
tree.description: Master modern deep learning: neural network architectures, PyTorch autograd engine, computer vision CNNs, attention mechanisms, Transformers, and Large Language Model fine-tuning.

resources.title: Fast.ai Practical Deep Learning for Coders
PyTorch for Deep Learning & Machine Learning (freeCodeCamp)
Neural Networks and Deep Learning Explained (Machine Learning Fundamentals)

children.name: Neural Network Fundamentals & PyTorch
children.description: Build deep neural networks with PyTorch. Understand the forward and backward propagation passes, activation functions (GELU, Swish, ReLU), weight initialization (He, Xavier), custom PyTorch nn.Module architecture, autograd computation graphs, and mixed-precision training (torch.amp).

resources.title: PyTorch for Deep Learning - Full Course

children.name: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)
children.description: Master Convolutional Neural Networks and modern computer vision architectures: convolution operations, receptive fields, residual skip connections (ResNet, ConvNeXt), and Vision Transformers (ViT). Implement advanced data augmentation pipelines with Albumentations.

resources.title: Stanford CS231n: Convolutional Neural Networks for Visual Recognition

children.name: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) & Sequence Models
children.description: Master sequence modeling and recurrent networks: LSTMs and GRUs, vanishing and exploding gradients, gated cell architectures, bidirectional sequence processing, and sequence-to-sequence models with encoder-decoder mechanisms for time-series forecasting.

resources.title: Stanford CS224N: Natural Language Processing with Deep Learning
Introduction to Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) | Deep Learning with PyTorch & Python
Word Embeddings Explained: Word2Vec, GloVe, FastText

children.name: Attention Mechanisms & Transformers
children.description: Deep dive into the Transformer architecture: Scaled Dot-Product Attention, Multi-Head Attention, Positional Encodings (Sinusoidal vs RoPE), Layer Normalization (Pre-LN vs RMSNorm), and the operational differences between encoder-only (BERT), decoder-only (GPT), and encoder-decoder (T5) models.

resources.title: Hugging Face Transformers Course - Use Transformers for NLP

children.name: Large Language Models (LLMs) & Generative AI
children.description: Master Large Language Models and generative AI: pre-training datasets, instruction fine-tuning, Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (LoRA, QLoRA), quantization methods (AWQ, GPTQ, GGUF), KV-caching for low-latency generation, and building production RAG pipelines with vector databases.

resources.title: Large Language Models (LLMs) Explained in 10 Minutes
Mastering Prompt Engineering for LLMs (Full Course)

children.name: Responsible AI & Ethics
children.description: Implement ethical and safe AI engineering: measuring model bias and demographic parity, adversarial robustness, mitigating hallucinations using guardrails (Llama Guard), watermarking AI-generated outputs, and implementing privacy-preserving techniques like differential privacy.

resources.title: Responsible AI: How to create ethical and fair AI systems
What is AI Ethics? (And why you should care)

tree.name: MLOps, Deployment & Portfolio
tree.description: Deploy, monitor, and scale machine learning systems in production. Master ML system design, low-latency model serving, feature stores, continuous monitoring, and automated retraining pipelines.

resources.title: MLOps Tutorial for Beginners | Full Course
Build & Deploy a Machine Learning Model (TensorFlow.js & Python Flask)

children.name: ML System Design & Architecture
children.description: Design scalable machine learning systems: resolve training-serving skew, evaluate online vs offline inference trade-offs, architect feature stores (Feast) for sub-millisecond retrieval, and design two-stage recommendation and search systems (candidate retrieval + deep ranking).

resources.title: Machine Learning System Design Interview Course

children.name: Model Deployment & Serving
children.description: Serve models with high throughput and low latency: Triton Inference Server, vLLM / TensorRT-LLM, model compilation with TensorRT and ONNX Runtime, dynamic batching, and building resilient model microservices with FastAPI and Docker.

resources.title: Deploy a Machine Learning Model with FastAPI and Docker

children.name: Experiment Tracking & Versioning
children.description: Maintain reproducibility across the ML lifecycle. Track experiments, parameters, and metrics with MLflow or Weights & Biases, version large training datasets and model artifacts with DVC, and manage model lifecycle transitions in an enterprise Model Registry.

resources.title: MLflow Complete Tutorial (Tracking, Projects, Models, Registry)
How to Version Control Your Data and Models for Machine Learning with DVC

children.name: Model Monitoring & Maintenance
children.description: Detect model decay in production: monitor data drift (Kolmogorov-Smirnov test) and concept drift (Population Stability Index / PSI) using Evidently AI, monitor p99 latency and inference throughput with Prometheus and Grafana, and trigger automated retraining alerts.

resources.title: MLOps Tutorial | Machine Learning Operations for Beginners

children.name: Project: End-to-End MLOps Pipeline
children.description: Capstone Project: Construct an automated end-to-end MLOps pipeline. Ingest streaming data, validate schema with Great Expectations, train and track models with MLflow, version datasets with DVC, deploy to Triton Inference Server on Kubernetes, and monitor drift in real time.

resources.title: MLOps Project Tutorial - Deploy a Machine Learning Model with AWS, Docker, and GitHub Actions

children.name: Career & Interview Preparation
children.description: Prepare for senior AI/ML engineering interviews: live PyTorch coding drills (implementing attention or custom loss functions from scratch), machine learning system design scenarios (designing a real-time fraud detector or feed ranker), and technical deep dives into model trade-offs.

resources.title: Cracking the Coding Interview (for general tech)
How To Get A Data Science Job (Even If You Have No Experience)
ML System Design Interview: A Complete Guide
